cases.title: Rationale values match ranking output
steps: Parse every numeric token in the same 10 rationales.
Compare displayed numbers with response values rounded to the displayed precision.
Recompute context PPP and delta from the returned fields.
cases.expected: Every cited number agrees with the returned metrics; no unsupported numerical claim.
cases.actual: All 75 cited numeric values matched. Context PPP equalled ML blend plus adjustment, and delta equalled context PPP minus baseline for all five context plays.
cases.limitation: The templates do not cite an uplift number. Legacy and NLP adjustments were derived from the returned component fields; the endpoint does not expose those two standalone fields.
cases.execution_comment: All 75 numbers quoted in the explanations matched the returned ranking values. The context PPP and delta calculations also matched for all five plays.

cases.title: Missing play-type dataset has a controlled error
steps: In an isolated child process, suppress dotenv file loading.
Make Path.exists return false only for synergy_playtypes_2019_2025_players.csv.
Import the backend startup module and capture exit status and error output.
cases.expected: A clear controlled error is returned or logged without an unhandled exception.
cases.actual: Startup exited 1 with an unhandled FileNotFoundError while importing the context recommender. The traceback identified the dataset path, but there was no controlled startup diagnostic.
cases.limitation: Only the child process saw the simulated missing file; the real dataset and production service were unchanged.
cases.scope_clarification: This is a startup/readiness contract gap. Missing auth configuration still fails closed at protected endpoints; the result does not demonstrate a security bypass.
cases.execution_comment: The isolated missing-dataset check ended with an unhandled FileNotFoundError. SCRUM-547 tracks a controlled startup/readiness diagnostic; the real dataset was unchanged.

cases.title: Top-K response time meets an agreed threshold
steps: Measure client-observed duration of the eight requests in BST-110.
Calculate the nearest-rank p95.
Look for an agreed deployed Top-K latency limit in the case and available project requirements.
cases.expected: The measured p95 is below the agreed threshold.
cases.actual: The eight-request sample had median 705.493 ms and p95 33,859.822 ms. No agreed deployed Top-K threshold was found, so no Pass/Fail decision was made.
cases.limitation: The existing local NLP parser threshold covers a different operation. One small sample cannot establish service capacity or a stable latency distribution; the source of the two slow requests is unconfirmed.
cases.execution_comment: The eight-request sample had a p95 of 33.86 seconds. This remains Verify until SCRUM-550 defines the deployed Top-K timing target and a repeatable measurement.

cases.title: Missing required configuration stops backend startup
steps: Start an isolated child process with Supabase environment values absent and insecure development auth disabled.
Disable dotenv loading in that child so private files cannot refill the removed value.
Import the backend, open lifespan and call /health.
cases.expected: Startup fails with a clear missing-configuration error.
cases.actual: Without SUPABASE_URL, startup still completed and /health returned 200 with status ok. No configuration error was logged at startup.
cases.limitation: This did not bypass authentication or change production configuration. Auth dependencies still fail closed on protected requests.
cases.scope_clarification: This is a startup/readiness contract gap. Missing auth configuration still fails closed at protected endpoints; the result does not demonstrate a security bypass.
cases.execution_comment: With auth configuration removed in an isolated process, startup still reported healthy. Protected requests still fail closed; SCRUM-547 will define the startup/readiness contract.
cases.jira_description:
Use-case coverage: UC62, UC64.

cases.title: Schema mapping reports missing and unmapped columns
steps: Use a five-row retained shot fixture in memory.
Remove TEAM_ABBR and run the model loader.
Separately add UNMAPPED_FIXTURE and repeat while capturing warnings and output.
cases.expected: Missing or unmapped input columns are reported.
cases.actual: Missing TEAM_ABBR produced a clear KeyError. The extra UNMAPPED_FIXTURE column was silently retained with no warning or diagnostic, so the unmapped-column check failed.
cases.limitation: Both fixtures were local copies; no dataset file was edited.
cases.scope_clarification: The fix should provide useful diagnostics for unmapped columns, not reject valid extra metadata.
cases.execution_comment: Removing TEAM_ABBR produced an error, but adding an unmapped column produced no diagnostic. SCRUM-548 tracks that warning without rejecting valid extra metadata.

cases.title: Shot features are complete and available before possession
steps: Inspect null values in the retained generated shot dataset.
Run the existing ML loader on a reproducible 20,000-row sample with seed 42 and check finite inputs.
Compare the feature specification with the stated pre-possession requirement.
cases.expected: No NaN/inf values and every feature is available before the possession.
cases.actual: All 1,332,515 retained MARGIN values were missing; the ML loader replaced them with zero. The 20,000-row model sample was finite, but actual shot type, location and related fields have no pre-possession input contract. This does not establish the required leakage-free feature set.
cases.limitation: This records the mismatch with the existing test requirement; it does not assert that conditional shot-quality modelling itself is invalid.
cases.execution_comment: Every retained shot margin was missing and became zero in the loader. SCRUM-538 and SCRUM-549 cover the data repair and the inputs that must be available before possession.
cases.jira_description:
Use-case coverage: UC70.



Steps:
1. Inspect null values in the retained generated shot dataset.
2. Run the existing ML loader on a reproducible 20,000-row sample with seed 42 and check finite inputs.
3. Compare the feature specification with the stated pre-possession requirement.

Expected result: No NaN/inf values and every feature is available before the possession.

Current result: Fail. All 1,332,515 retained MARGIN values were missing; the ML loader replaced them with zero. The 20,000-row model sample was finite, but actual shot type, location and related fields have no pre-possession input contract. This does not establish the required leakage-free feature set.

Scope: This records the mismatch with the existing test requirement; it does not assert that conditional shot-quality modelling itself is invalid.
